snippet.title: CASHGRAB - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
CASHGRAB is an arcade time-attack 2D platformer.

Play as Joey, a duck who sold the rights to a movie adaptation of his last adventure. He has to run, jump, stomp and dash to defeat enemies and grab the cash as fast as he can because the producers want to complete the movie as fast as possible!

But at least he can star in it.

Wishlist now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5194400/CASHGRAB/
